title: DDGC UI Migration Foundation — Runtime Page Families
description: Shared migration foundation for the repeated dungeon-runtime and expedition-planning page families. Establishes route/screen/component boundaries, runtime/headless view-model adapter expectations, navigation conventions, shared state-slot mapping, and a reusable screenshot parity pattern.

expedition-planning.description: 位面探索 / Plane Exploration — pre-dungeon party selection, provisioning, and launch flow

screens.notes: Plane selection uses QingLong/BaiHu/ZhuQue/XuanWu theme colors. Party slots are read-only in current build; hero toggling is stubbed.
Alternative entry path from town. Dungeon options derive from CampaignQuestProgress and DungeonMapConfig.
Supply items are hardcoded in LiveRuntimeBridge; headless adapter does not yet produce SupplyItem[] from campaign state.
Pre-entry briefing screen. Tips/warnings/expectedEnemies are static strings in current build.
Final pre-launch review. Warnings derive from hero vitals vs. quest difficulty.

dungeon-runtime.description: 副本 / Dungeon Runtime — in-dungeon exploration, interaction, combat, and settlement flow

screens.notes: Pre-dungeon buff/heal screen. Assist actions are stubbed in LiveRuntimeBridge; headless run does not yet produce assist actions.
Map topology derived from framework_progression::Floor. Room connections use framework rooms_map. Revealed/visited state is game-layer ephemeral.
Room type drives available interactions. Combat rooms auto-transition to combat screen. Event/Corridor rooms show interaction buttons.
Combat phase machine: player-turn → character-hit → continue → next hero. Framework CombatViewModel is bridged through adapter.
Outcome derives from RunResult (Victory/Defeat) and DdgcRunState (rooms_cleared, battles_won, casualties).
Return flow bridges dungeon completion back to town. Hero vitals carried from DdgcRunResult heroes.

headless_to_ui_contract.description: The headless game runtime (Rust) produces typed view models via adapters. The frontend (TypeScript/SolidJS) consumes these through RuntimeBridge with no framework-specific types leaking across the boundary.

layer_responsibilities.src/contracts/viewmodels.rs: Canonical Rust view model types (serde-compatible). All screen-state shapes are defined here.
layer_responsibilities.src/contracts/adapters.rs: Pure conversion functions from framework payloads to DDGC view models. No side effects.
layer_responsibilities.src/state/mod.rs: NavigationShell, FlowState, GameState with ephemeral state slots (active_expedition, active_combat, active_result, active_return_flow).
layer_responsibilities.frontend/src/bridge/contractTypes.ts: TypeScript mirror of Rust view models. Must stay synchronized with Rust types.
layer_responsibilities.frontend/src/bridge/RuntimeBridge.ts: Abstract bridge interface. Live and Replay implementations dispatch intents and emit snapshots.
layer_responsibilities.frontend/src/session/FlowController.ts: Screen resolution (resolveScreen) and transition validation (canTransition). Screen-key dispatch, not business logic.

headless_to_ui_contract.type_sync_rule: When a Rust view model field is added/removed/changed, the TypeScript contractTypes.ts equivalent MUST be updated in the same PR. The FlowController.resolveScreen switch must cover the new kind.
forbidden_leakage: framework_rules::ActorId must not appear in contract JSON or TypeScript types — use String ids.
framework_progression::RoomId must not appear in contract JSON — use String room_id.
framework_combat::CombatSide must not appear in contract JSON — use 'hero' | 'monster' enum.
Any framework internal type (Run, Floor, EncounterResolver) must stay inside src/run/ and never reach src/contracts/viewmodels.rs.

LiveRuntimeBridge.snapshot_production: Boot creates fresh campaign via DdgcHost::boot_live. Intent dispatch mutates local snapshot and emits to subscribers.
LiveRuntimeBridge.determinism: Same intent sequence from same boot state must produce identical snapshot sequence.
LiveRuntimeBridge.view_model_completeness: Every DdgcViewModel kind must have a createLive*ViewModel factory for local development and smoke testing.

ReplayRuntimeBridge.snapshot_production: Boot loads replay fixtures. Intent dispatch replays pre-recorded state transitions.
ReplayRuntimeBridge.fixture_coverage: Every screen key must have a replay fixture in frontend/src/validation/replayFixtures.ts.

state_slot_mapping.description: GameState ephemeral slots hold the active runtime state for each page family. These slots are NOT persisted in CampaignState JSON — they are reconstructed from the persisted campaign + run history on load.

slots.lifecycle: Set on expedition launch. Cleared on return-to-town or result acknowledgement.
slots.reconstruction: From CampaignState.run_history + quest progress + selected party heroes.
slots.notes: The DdgcRunResult contains the framework Run, Floor, and room_encounters. Adapters consume this to produce dungeon and exploration view models.

slots.lifecycle: Set on combat entry. Cleared on combat end (victory/defeat/flee).
slots.reconstruction: From active_expedition.run + current room encounter pack + hero states.
slots.notes: CombatState holds hero_vitals and monster_vitals as CombatantVitalViewModel (not framework types). Framework combat resolver updates this slot via adapter.

slots.lifecycle: Set on combat end or dungeon completion. Cleared on continue-from-result.
slots.notes: ResultState.view_model is ResultViewModel. Source field tracks whether result came from Combat or Expedition.

slots.lifecycle: Set on continue-from-result. Cleared on resume-from-return.
slots.reconstruction: From active_expedition metadata + hero states + run outcome.
slots.notes: ReturnFlowState.view_model is ReturnFlowViewModel. journey_complete flag gates resume-from-return.

transition_table.ExpeditionPlanning → Provisioning: Frontend intent proceed-to-provisioning (no NavigationShell transition; stays in Expedition flow state until launch)
transition_table.Expedition → Result: NavigationShell::transition_to_result() on dungeon completion or party wipe

entry_semantics.description: Every screen has exactly one canonical entry intent. Entry intents are guarded by canTransition in FlowController and by NavigationShell::can_transition in Rust.
entry_semantics.combat_entry: enter-room when room type == combat (from dungeon-map only)

return_semantics.description: return-to-town is a universal escape intent available from all non-town screens except during character-hit acknowledgement. It resets ephemeral state slots and returns to FlowState::Town.
return_semantics.guard: FlowController::canTransition rejects return-to-town when already in town/startup/loading. Rejects during character-hit phase in combat.
return_semantics.state_cleanup: On return-to-town: clear active_expedition, active_combat, active_result, active_return_flow. Preserve campaign state.

continue_semantics.description: Continue intents move forward within a flow family. They are gated by readiness flags in the view model.
continue_semantics.continue-from-result: Gated by ResultViewModel.isContinueAvailable. Transitions to Return flow.
continue_semantics.resume-from-return: Gated by ReturnViewModel.isTownResumeAvailable. Transitions to Town flow.
continue_semantics.continue-from-dungeon: Gated by DungeonAssistViewModel.canContinue. Transitions to dungeon-map.
continue_semantics.continue-from-combat: Gated by combat phase == character-hit. Acknowledges hit and transitions to result.
continue_semantics.proceed-dungeon: Gated by DungeonInteractionViewModel.isProceedAvailable. Transitions to result or next room.
continue_semantics.pattern: All continue intents use canTransition validation against both screen key and view-model readiness flags.

intent_naming_convention.rule: Intent names must be unique across the entire DdgcFrontendIntent union. New intents must update FlowController.canTransition with explicit screen guards.

adapter_properties.purity: Adapters are pure functions: no side effects, no state mutation, no I/O. Input: framework payload + campaign state. Output: ViewModelResult<T>.
adapter_properties.error_surface: Unsupported or partial states produce ViewModelError explicitly. Screens must render error surfaces rather than silent partial data.
adapter_properties.completeness: Every field in the frontend TypeScript view model must be produced by a corresponding Rust adapter. No optional field may be left unmapped without a documented blocker.

provisioning_from_campaign.gap: SupplyItem[] is not yet produced from campaign state. Supply items are hardcoded in LiveRuntimeBridge. Classification: game-gap (supply system not yet modeled in headless runtime).

expedition_setup_from_data.gap: Warnings derive from static heuristics (HP < 50%, stress > 75%). Full condition evaluation requires quirk/disease subsystems. Classification: game-gap.

dungeon_from_run_result.gap: Room cleared state is not yet tracked in DdgcRunResult. All rooms show cleared=false. Classification: game-gap.

exploration_hud_from_dungeon.gap: None. Lightweight subset adapter is complete.

room_movement_from_run.gap: None. Interaction type mapping from RoomKind is complete.

encounter_entry_from_run.gap: None. Hero state and pack composition are mapped.

combat_from_framework.gap: ActorSummary lacks slot_index, name, family_id, stress. Uses placeholders. Classification: framework-gap (ActorSummary shape) or game-gap (adapter workaround). Recorded as game-gap since adapter workaround is sufficient for current parity.

result_from_run.input: DungeonType + MapSize + rooms_cleared + battles_won + completed + gold_earned + xp_earned + heirlooms + casualties
result_from_run.gap: None. All parameters map to view model fields.

return_flow_from_state.input: DungeonType + MapSize + rooms_cleared + battles_won + completed + gold_earned + heroes[] + died_heroes[]
return_flow_from_state.gap: None. All parameters map to view model fields.

test_structure.fixture_stage: Load replay fixture for target screen key into ReplayRuntimeBridge.
test_structure.render_stage: Mount DdgcApp with ReplayRuntimeBridge. Wait for resolveScreen to match target screen key.
test_structure.capture_stage: Take viewport screenshot at 1920x1080. Compare against reference image using pixelmatch with threshold 0.1.
test_structure.report_stage: If diff pixels > 1% of total, fail test and emit diff overlay. If reference image missing, emit 'reference_missing' warning and pass with note.

annotations.data-source-scene: Each screen root element must carry data-source-scene attribute matching original Unity hierarchy (e.g., UI_Quest/SelectedQuestPanel).
annotations.data-source-prefab: Each screen root element should carry data-source-prefab attribute for traceability.
annotations.data-blocker: Known parity gaps (missing portraits, placeholder data) must be marked with data-blocker attributes referencing blocker IDs.

coverage_requirements.review_evidence: At 30% review, at least one screen per family must have a passing screenshot parity test with diff < 1%.

dependency_order.description: Foundation tasks must complete before page-specific screenshot tasks. Adapter gaps must close before screenshot parity can pass.

phases.name: Close adapter gaps
phases.deliverable: Headless adapters produce complete view models for provisioning and dungeon screens.

phases.name: Validate navigation guards
phases.deliverable: Rust NavigationShell and TypeScript FlowController cover all transitions with regression tests.

phases.name: Screenshot parity for expedition-planning family
phases.deliverable: expedition-planning and provisioning screens pass pixel-diff < 1% against reference images.

phases.name: Screenshot parity for dungeon-runtime family
phases.deliverable: dungeon-interaction, combat, dungeon-map, and result screens pass pixel-diff < 1% against reference images.

review_evidence_30pct.description: At the 30% review checkpoint, the following evidence must be present in the repository.
required_artifacts: At least one closed adapter gap (T-001 or T-002) with passing Rust test.
At least one passing screenshot parity spec (T-003 through T-009) with pixel diff < 1%.
FlowController.test.ts covers all intents for both page families with allowed + rejected cases (T-011).
All screen keys in both families have replay fixtures and pass ScreenKey exhaustiveness test (T-012).
NavigationShell integration test covers Expedition → Combat → Result → Return → Town (T-010).
validation_commands: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/session/FlowController.test.ts

game_gaps.description: SupplyItem[] not produced from campaign state in provisioning adapter.
game_gaps.resolution: Implement supply system in game layer (src/state/ or src/town/). No framework changes.

game_gaps.description: Expedition warnings use static heuristics instead of full quirk/disease evaluation.
game_gaps.resolution: Wire quirk/disease subsystems into expedition_setup_from_data. No framework changes.

game_gaps.description: Dungeon room cleared state not tracked in DdgcRunResult.
game_gaps.resolution: Add room_cleared tracking to run state. No framework changes.

game_gaps.description: combat_from_framework uses placeholders for ActorSummary fields (slot_index, name, family_id, stress).
game_gaps.resolution: Adapter workaround is sufficient for current parity. If framework ActorSummary is extended, update adapter. No framework changes required for DDGC parity.

atlas_compliance.dependency_direction: DDGC_newArch consumes framework_rules, framework_combat, framework_progression, framework_viewmodels via public APIs. No DDGC-specific content is placed in framework crates.
atlas_compliance.contract_boundary: All frontend-facing types are defined in src/contracts/viewmodels.rs with serde support. No framework types leak into contract JSON.
atlas_compliance.state_flow: NavigationShell in src/state/mod.rs owns flow transitions. Both replay-driven and live-runtime modes use the same transition API.
atlas_compliance.documentation: All developer startup, runtime wiring, and adapter behavior is verified through docs smoke tests and adapter/viewmodel tests.
atlas_compliance.placement_verification: Every gap in this plan is classified as game-gap. No framework-gap or core-gap blockers exist for these page families.
